newsitem.title: USA: ABC Projects Democrats will keep control of House.
newsitem.headline: ABC Projects Democrats will keep control of House.

text.p: Republicans will keep control of the House of Representatives despite a heated challenge from Democrats in Tuesday's balloting, according to projections by the ABC television network.

Republicans took control of the House in 1994 for the first time in 40 years. Democrats had hoped to pick up 19 seats to take back control of the 435-seat chamber, but appear to be falling short of that target, the network said. With election results still coming in from across the country, it is unclear what the final breakdown in the chamber will be.
